Interface ExecutionModeProvider

All Superinterfaces:
MethodBasedProvider<ExecutionMode>
All Known Implementing Classes:
CombinatorialTestAnnotationBasedExecutionModeProvider
Functional Interface:
This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
@FunctionalInterface public interface ExecutionModeProvider extends MethodBasedProvider<ExecutionMode>
An ExecutionModeProvider is responsible for providing exactly one ExecutionMode for use in a CombinatorialTest.

Pre default, CombinatorialTestAnnotationBasedExecutionModeProvider is used. To register a custom ExecutionModeProvider, use the ExecutionModeSource annotation (can be used as a meta annotation).

Implementations must provide a no-args constructor.

This is more or less a copy of org.junit.jupiter.params.provider.ArgumentsProvider from the junit-jupiter-params project.
